lines.t: In the quiet of the evening, I whisper all my prayers to you
Of all the things I thank you for
And of how much I love you
I long for when you take me
Gather me up to you
I have been waiting
I know your promise is true
I'm watching at the window
I know, listen for the sound of you calling me
Oh, my brood, brood
Come quickly
I long for the day when
You come and take me
My heart yearns to be with you
I feel a love so strong
A love so true that I've had for you
For so long my pride grew
Come take me
Through the waiting and the longing
Through the joy and tears
You've been my steady promise
Through the passing years
Though I cannot see you still
I know you are nearby
That you are gazing down on me from high
My bridegroom, my first love
I can't wait until you take me, take me up above
Oh, my bridegroom, come quickly
I long for the day when you come and take me
My heart yearns to be with you
I feel a love so strong, a love so true
That I've had for you
For so long my cry grew
Come take me
You are the holy promised one
Every tear will fade away
When you call my name that day
I will run into your arms
Safe within your love
Oh, my bridegroom
Come quickly
I long for the day when
You'll come and take me
My heart yearns to be with you
I feel a love so strong
A love so true that I've had for you
Come take me.
